name: Quality Management Orchestrator
description: Orchestrates quality management workflows across SAP and Box systems for CAPA tracking, document management, regulatory intelligence analysis, and QMSR compliance.

skills.name: Quality Management Orchestrator
skills.description: Routes quality management queries to SAP and Box agents for CAPA tracking, document management, and QMSR compliance
examples: Compare the new QMSR final rule against the old 21 CFR 820 QSR and generate a gap analysis report
What changed with the §820.180(c) exemption removal and which of our SOPs are affected?
Show me all open CAPAs related to the QMSR transition and their current status
Which controlled documents were revised in January 2026 for QMSR compliance?
What does our management review SOP say about FDA inspection readiness under the new QMSR?
Are there any supplier quality notifications tied to CAPA 000300000005?
